title: Pocketwire Personal Account Security Lock and Recovery Standard
content:
**Lock.** A support representative places a security lock on a Pocketwire Personal Account when the verified customer reports a login, device change or payment they did not make, or when the customer reports that their phone number or email was taken over; the lock stops every money movement except incoming credits.

**Recovery approval.** Recovery requires an account recovery request whose request status is approved, which the review team sets after the customer passes the plan's identity re-verification method in the app. The request status is read from the system record of the customer's request.

**Cooling-off.** Recovery completes only after the cooling-off period: recovery is recorded no earlier than the plan's recovery cooling-off in full hours after the security lock time. The cooling-off period is counted in full elapsed hours from the security lock time recorded on the account, and recovery at exactly the end of the period qualifies.

**After recovery.** Recovery sets the recovered date, and the post-recovery send cap of the sending rules of the Pocketwire Personal Account applies from that date; unauthorized payments made before the lock are handled separately as unauthorized-payment claims and are not refunded by recovery itself.

**No other route.** A customer who cannot pass the identity re-verification method cannot be recovered by a representative on the strength of other information, however convincing.

### Conditions of recovery

| Account recovery request approved? | Full hours elapsed since the lock at least the plan's cooling-off? | Recovery can be recorded? |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes or no | No |

### Cooling-off boundary (hypothetical, a 48-hour cooling-off)

- Lock recorded at 10:00 on a given day: recovery at 10:00 two days later is exactly 48 full hours and qualifies.
- Recovery at 09:59 that same day is 47 full hours and does not qualify.
